card.name: Words signaling few or rare occurrences
card.fires_on: Words that express small quantity or rarity, such as 'small' after 'a few' or 'several', 'rarely', 'any', 'potential', and sentence-ending periods after overdose reports. Mostly in overdosage text and geography descriptions.

modes.label: Small-quantity words
modes.description: Words like 'small', 'rarely' or 'any' that limit how many or how much.

modes.label: End of overdose finding
modes.description: A period or closing mark after a short overdose or animal-dose statement.

modes.label: Hedging verbs and qualifiers
modes.description: Words such as 'resulted' or 'potential' in negated or hedged statements.
modes.example: have not<< resulted>> in any specific symptoms other than vomiting.
